Tip: To survive in the wasteland, always pay attention to your surroundings. The compass can help if you turn the compass indicators on.
Beware of warboys. They use blast lances and can jump to their death.
Enemy vehicle patrols roam the wastes. Stay away, fight or flee.
To stop a travelling Coyotes merchant, honk or yell.
Beware! In Wild Wasteland, animals and mutants have learnt some new tricks.
If you add water and raw food to a stew pot and boil it periodically, it never spoils. Eternal stew!
Press 'crawl' to get to hard to reach places.
Hold Reload to unload the gun in your hands. You can also drop equipment, ammo and nuts from your inventory screen.
Binoculars help you see the location name and allegiance. They also help to uncover more of the 'fog of war' on the map.
Excess armor drops as plates when changing to lower-capacity armor; each complete 50 excess points produces one plate.
Pick up matching bandages or first aid to refill a partially used pack to three uses. Any excess stays on the ground.
Open the inventory screen and click equipped gearm ammo, nuts or first aid items to drop them.
Gunshots, explosions, engines, horns, shouts and thrown items can draw enemies.
Enemies investigate your last known position after losing sight. Moving away can shake a search. Hounds and other tracking creatures can follow you more effectively.
Darkness reduces enemy sight range, but your flashlight can reveal you.
Scrapyard patrols can include working two-wheel motorcycles.
The War Rig tanker has an accessible interior and hitches to the Rustchief. Inside the War Rig tank, you are protected from storm damage and tornado forces.
Aim at a friendly human nearby and press F to ask about work or hiring. Press J to review your jobs and deadlines.
